face_landmarker.description: MediaPipe FaceLandmarker (float16, 478 landmarks) — used by detection.py for face landmark extraction.

selfie_segmenter.description: MediaPipe Selfie Segmenter (TFLite) — person/hair segmentation fallback in detection.py.

resnet18_bisenet.description: BiSeNet face-parsing model (ResNet-18 backbone, ONNX) — per-region face masks in parsing.py.

retinaface_mv1.description: RetinaFace MobileNetV1 (ONNX) — face bounding-box detector used by detection.py (primary path).

lama_inpaint.description: LaMa large-region inpainting model (ONNX) — placeholder for F4.b. Not yet bundled; sha256/size set on acquisition.

sr_real_esrgan.description: Real-ESRGAN x4plus super-resolution model (ONNX) — placeholder for F7, NOT bundled: the url above is a template host and will not resolve. Until this lands, AIEnhancer.super_resolve falls back to Lanczos (it logs a warning saying so). On acquisition set sha256/size and note: must be the x4 model (_SR_NATIVE_SCALE=4 is hardcoded) exported with dynamic H/W axes (_tiled_inference feeds variable tile shapes); export via the upstream scripts/pytorch2onnx.py to keep the BSD-3-Clause provenance claimed here.

denoise_nafnet.description: NAFNet-SIDD-width32 denoise model (ONNX, opset 17, dynamic H/W, RGB [0,1] NCHW) — exported via scripts/models/export_nafnet_onnx.py from megvii-research/NAFNet weights. Used by enhance.py AIEnhancer.denoise (F7).
